notes.title: Christmas Update 1.4.9 is out in beta branch
notes.notes:
- Redesigned editor
- New enemies/blocks available in builder
- Controller/keyboard ui navigation
- Keybindings for useful actions
- Better workshop support
- Import 3D models (.fbx, .collada, etc...)
- Build-in visual scripting

Play marble race during Christmas sale and unlock special skin
